name: Code of Reality
detailed_description:
Code of Reality is an innovative story-driven adventure featuring interactive AI and a breathtakingly realistic game world. Explore an open world where NPCs communicate with you in an unprecedented way and bring their own unique stories. Drive various vehicles, explore the environment with a No-Clip mode, and make decisions that shape the course of the story.

Features:

✅ Dynamic NPC interaction – Your conversations with characters are influenced by AI and change depending on the course of the game.
✅ Super realistic game world – Highly detailed environments, realistic physics, and stunning graphical effects fully immerse you in the world.
✅ Vehicles for exploration – Take control of various vehicles and discover the world your way.
✅ No-Clip exploration mode – Fly freely through the world and experience it from any perspective.
✅ Deep story – Every decision matters! Your actions determine the course of the story and how NPCs react.
✅ AI-powered dialogues – Unique characters with their own personalities that adapt to your behavior.

Dive into Code of Reality and experience an interactive world full of possibilities!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X / Intel Core i7-9700K (8 Cores)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 (8 GB VRAM) oder AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: An NVMe SSD with high read speed is strongly recommended. HDDs may cause performance drops. These system requirements are optimized for 1080p. More powerful GPUs are required for higher resolutions. Raytracing and DLSS 3.0 are recommended for the best possible performance. VR support is in development and may be added in future updates.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7900X / Intel Core i9-12900K (12 Cores)
  • Memory: 64 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4080 oder besser (16 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: An NVMe SSD with high read speed is strongly recommended. HDDs may cause performance drops. These system requirements are optimized for 1080p. More powerful GPUs are required for higher resolutions. Raytracing and DLSS 3.0 are recommended for the best possible performance. VR support is in development and may be added in future updates.

legal_notice:
Legal Notice:
This game uses Convai AI for NPC interaction and voice control. All chat inputs in the game are transmitted to Convai AI and processed there. The developer has no access to the transmitted data and does not store or process it.

For privacy-related inquiries or questions about data processing, please contact Convai AI directly. Further information can be found in their Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
